clips.title: The story
paras: At Camp Narache, Lanka Farshot guides young tauren onto the hunter's path. He is stationed within the Red Cloud Mesa and teaches tracking, marksmanship, and survival on Mulgore's plains.

At Camp Narache, Lanka Farshot welcomes new tauren called to the hunter's path. Fresh recruits arrive with an etched note that sends them to seek his counsel. Under his guidance, they learn ranged combat, how to track prey, and respect for the wild beasts roaming Mulgore's grassy plains. He prepares each young hunter to scout and provide for the tribe.
